ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Repplay uses the camera to record your clips.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Repplay records the sound of your clips.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Repplay listens for you to say "save" or "record" so you can save a clip without touching your phone.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Repplay saves the clips you export to your photo library.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Repplay uses your local network to show the camera image on the phone you use as a remote.
